about_the_game:
Loot of Idle

Loot of Idle invites you to an endless adventure in a pixel art world. Monsters descend upon you in waves, and as you defeat them, various items drop. You collect and equip these items, continuously upgrade them, and further strengthen your character through the enchantment and spell systems.

You constantly encounter increasingly powerful enemies, while the occasional bosses add excitement to the challenge. The game's focus is on creating item combinations with a relaxed and chilled experience. With strategic builds, the right upgrades, and patience, you'll find yourself ready for increasingly challenging challenges as you progress.

Thanks to Idle's gameplay mechanics, progress continues even when you're not in the game. When you log back in, you'll encounter new items, power-ups, and surprises to discover. Loot of Idle appeals to both those seeking a relaxed pixel atmosphere and those seeking the pleasure of in-depth development and item stacking.
